title: macOS FreeCAD 1.1.4 generated AC1024 primitive open/insert qualification
status: PASS for generated AC1024 geometry open/insert route only

source.provenance: Generated from scratch at test runtime by the libdxfrw DWG writer; no fixture file was committed.

test_changes.details: The generated primitive source and installed-converter harness now accept AC1021 or AC1024. The existing AC1021 open/insert checks still pass; the AC1024 pair is registered under the existing optional FreeCAD primitive-control switch. Linux and Windows workflow selectors now include the lowercase AC1024 test names.

validation.sandbox: Qt aborted before import in the sandbox because it could not detect ARM NEON; the same focused tests passed when rerun outside the sandbox.

scope_limit: Generated AC1024 geometry on macOS ARM64 only. This does not qualify physical producer files, FreeCAD 1.1.3, native DWG, ACIS solids, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, Linux/Windows, ABI, or general DWG/3D support claims.
